comment: Provider data-use, retention, training and residency facts for the data-use gate (ADR-0016 section 6; CAP-MODEL-09, CAP-MODEL-10, CAP-MODEL-04 rights). Values are transcribed from the verified capability records (register verified 2026-10-22); each provider lists its record ids and source pages. retention_days null = not recorded/unbounded, which blocks any artifact whose owner ceiling is finite. Master API terms of OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI were not fetched (CAP-MODEL-09 open question): confirm contractual wording before production. Legal-hold and flagged-content retention exceptions exist for every provider and are not modelled as the default.

training.basis: API data is not used to train or improve OpenAI models unless the customer opts in.

generate.basis: Abuse monitoring logs up to 30 days for all API usage; the Responses API keeps 30-day application state by default and the adapter sends store=false. Effective retention under ZDR/MAM is not recorded.

count_tokens.basis: Retention for counting calls is not stated; treat as the provider default (CAP-MODEL-04).

batch.basis: Batches are not ZDR-eligible; output files are deleted 30 days after completion; input files are kept until deleted.

eu.note: eu.api.openai.com; requires ZDR, Modified Abuse Monitoring, Private Retention with PSP, or Safety Retention.

training.basis: Retained data is never used for training without express permission.

generate.basis: Conversation content is not retained by default; Covered Models require 30-day retention.

count_tokens.basis: Token counting is ZDR-eligible, excluding Covered Models.

covered_models.note: Display names from CAP-MODEL-09; ids from the Claude API reference model table. The Mythos 5 id is not recorded.

fallback_targets.note: Supported server-side refusal-fallback targets per the Claude API reference ('expansion expected'). Used to bound the worst-case cost of a fallback attempt; a response served by any other model is booked at its reservation and flagged.

training.basis: Never trains on API inputs or outputs without explicit permission.

generate.basis: Stored encrypted for 30 days for auditing; ZDR (team admin toggle or sales) removes it.

count_tokens.basis: Retention for tokenize calls is not stated; treat as the provider default (CAP-MODEL-04).

batch.basis: Batch API is unavailable under ZDR.

us.note: https://us.api.x.ai/v1 serves only the listed models; a regional endpoint is not by itself a comprehensive residency guarantee.

training.basis: Unpaid Services content may be used to improve products and read by human reviewers; Paid Services prompts and responses are not used to improve products.

generate.basis: Paid tier: logged for a limited period for abuse detection (period not quantified, CAP-MODEL-09 open question); Interactions stored 55 days unless store=false, which the adapter always sends.

count_tokens.basis: Not stated; treat as the provider default (CAP-MODEL-04).

global.note: Logged data may be stored transiently or cached in any country where Google or its agents maintain facilities.
